papers.title_en: Lunar Surface Receiver Clock Synchronization Using GNSS and Satellite Nadir Angle
papers.authors: Minju Han, Seunghyeon Park, Joon Hyo Rhee
papers.evidence: 月面GNSS定位授时与钟差同步
papers.tldr: 月球表面利用地球轨道GNSS信号实现定位、导航与授时，已由LuGRE实验验证。接收机钟差卡尔曼滤波性能依赖卫星测量不确定性建模，而地面常用仰角加权在月球数据中因仰角范围窄而区分度有限。卫星天底角变化范围更宽，且小角度时测量波动明显增大。为此，研究提出融合卫星天底角与载噪比的测量加权模型，并利用七个LuGRE运行段进行评估。结果表明，该模型在六个运行段取得最低钟差均方根误差，总体误差为5.78米，较最佳对比模型降低19.5%，并在模拟测量中断下保持最优钟差预测。
papers.abstract_en: The use of signals from Earth-orbiting Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS) constellations for positioning, navigation, and timing on the lunar surface was recently demonstrated by the Lunar GNSS Receiver Experiment (LuGRE) aboard Blue Ghost Mission 1. For receiver clock synchronization using GNSS, Kalman filter performance depends on the satellite-specific measurement uncertainty used to construct the measurement noise covariance. Terrestrial measurement weighting commonly relies on receiver elevation angle, but the elevation angles in the analyzed LuGRE data are confined to 24.2-31.5 degrees, providing limited discrimination of measurement quality. In contrast, satellite nadir angles span 12.1-66.6 degrees, and the measurement variability increases substantially at small nadir angles. Based on this observation, we propose a measurement weighting model that combines satellite nadir angle with C/N0 for lunar surface receiver clock synchronization. The proposed model is evaluated against three weighting methods adopted from the literature using seven LuGRE operation periods (OPs). It achieves the lowest receiver clock bias root mean square error (RMSE) in six of the seven OPs and an overall RMSE of 5.78 m, which is 19.5% lower than that of the best comparison model. The proposed model also provides the lowest clock bias prediction RMSE under simulated measurement outages.

papers.title_en: OrbitTAMP: Grounding Language Models for Task and Motion Planning in Spacecraft Rendezvous
papers.authors: Yuji Takubo, Daniele Gammelli, Marco Pavone, Simone D'Amico
papers.evidence: 基于轨道动力学的航天器交会接近操作任务与运动规划
papers.tldr: 航天器交会与近距离操作（RPO）规划依赖专家，将高层意图转化为安全可行轨迹，成为规模化瓶颈。本文提出OrbitTAMP分层TAMP框架，用可复用行为图和领域规划模块为LLM推理提供物理接地。预训练LLM将自然语言命令映射为部分任务规格，规划器补全未定决策，轨迹优化生成动态可行轨迹。实验显示部分任务规格精确恢复率达98%，9B模型经验证器引导修正从75%提升至88%，为语言驱动的RPO规划提供可扩展、可审计基础。
papers.abstract_en: Spacecraft rendezvous and proximity operations (RPO) are currently planned through an expertise-intensive process in which engineers translate high-level operational intent into safe, dynamically feasible trajectories, creating a bottleneck to scalable operations. Large language model (LLM)-based agents could offer an intuitive interface for this process, although their outputs are not inherently grounded in orbital dynamics, operational constraints, or the structure of admissible spacecraft maneuvers. To exploit their semantic reasoning while ensuring the generated plan's physical validity, this paper presents a hierarchical framework for spacecraft task-and-motion planning (TAMP) that grounds LLM reasoning in a graph of reusable behaviors and domain-specific planning modules. Within this framework, a pretrained LLM maps a natural-language command to a partial mission specification. The associated planners then resolve unspecified decisions within the admissible operational space. Finally, trajectory optimization converts the completed mission specification into a dynamically feasible trajectory. Numerical experiments demonstrate that this architecture substantially improves intent recovery over direct LLM generation, achieving 98% exact recovery of partial mission specifications across all evaluated splits when backed by frontier LLMs. Additional test-time-compute experiments show that, for a compact 9B model, verifier-guided revision increases exact recovery from 75% to 88%, while broader behavior-plan search independently improves selection among admissible trajectory realizations. Overall, these results establish a scalable and auditable foundation for language-driven agentic planning of spacecraft RPO.
